name: Camp Allen New Hampshire
description_short: Camp Allen in Bedford, NH has run camp for people with developmental and/or physical disabilities since 1931. Residential sessions are for campers six and up (with a Kids Week and a Mobility Access Week), and Day Camp runs Monday to Friday, 9am to 3:30pm, one-to-one with a counselor.
special_needs_notes: The camp serves only people with developmental and/or physical disabilities. Residential campers choose a 2:1 or 1:1 camper to counselor ratio (1:1 adds $450 to $720); Day Camp is always 1:1. Nurses are on duty at all times, the campus is fully accessible, and activities are adapted. Mobility Access Week is for campers who use canes, walkers or wheelchairs. Campers on more than two prescriptions need pharmacy pre-packaging or a $250 medication fee.
